build_projective_transform_identity: build a ProjectiveTransform with a default identity 3x3 matrix for batched coordinate transformations
apply_forward_transform: apply a forward projective transformation to batched 2D coordinates using the ProjectiveTransform callable
apply_inverse_transform: apply the inverse projective transformation to batched 2D coordinates using the inverse method
estimate_transform_matrix_svd: estimate a projective transformation matrix from source to destination coordinates using SVD method
center_and_normalize_points: center and normalize batched 2D points for improved numerical stability in transformation estimation
